_doc: RECORDED-EVIDENCE replay corpus (NOT raw-snapshot replay). Every pageState field is transcribed from the case's stored assertionCheckResults evidence string in prisma/dev.db, run 90002e1c. The run was CANCELLED so raw accessibility snapshots were not persisted; the stored evidence documents PAGE IDENTITY only (login page, /auth/login, form fields present) and is SILENT on whether a field-level validation error rendered. Per the honesty rule we therefore set fieldErrors/pageErrors to null (= NOT captured = unobservable) rather than fabricate a 'Required' message. Inputs are inferred from the poisoned pageName (the substituted error string names the blank field); a4db8be0's pageName '(none)' gives no reliable input basis, so it is recorded as provenance only and NOT modeled for the contract proof.
